title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making its powerful capabilities available to everyone.

title: Complete File Control and Customization
summary: Users can now effortlessly manage, upload, download, and customize the visual presentation of all their files and images directly within the editor for a tailored creative flow.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap page, giving you a clear view of what's shipped, what's next, and what's planned.

title: Revamped Checkboxes
summary: Experience a significant upgrade with bigger, easier-to-click, and draggable checkboxes, designed to seamlessly integrate with your modern workflow and boost productivity.

title: Seamless Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Experience smoother teamwork with enhanced real-time collaboration that keeps everyone perfectly in sync.

title: Unlock Collaborative Sharing
summary: Easily discover and work together on shared items with your connections, making collaboration more seamless and productive than ever before.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We're thrilled to introduce extensive multilingual capabilities, enabling you to seamlessly use Noeko in your native language across the globe.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We're thrilled to open Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with maximum control, transparency, and a direct role in shaping its exciting future.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge with Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Transform your knowledge exploration with an enhanced Constellation View, offering dynamic filtering and improved visibility into your shared content and connections.

title: Advanced Search with Saved Knowledge Views
summary: This powerful update empowers you to pinpoint exactly what you need by applying advanced filters and sorting options, then saving your curated search results as personalized knowledge collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Explore new, flexible ways to display and interact with linked content, creating a more intuitive and personalized environment for organizing your thoughts.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting & Premium Plans
summary: Experience unprecedented control and unlock advanced capabilities with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting options and flexible premium plans, empowering you to tailor your deployment and features to perfection.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Beautiful New Themes
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual refresh as we polish current themes and introduce an exciting collection of new designs, allowing you to tailor Noeko to your unique style.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're ensuring our greetings always reflect the exact time of day, providing a more precise and delightful experience on your homepage.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Quickly remove items from your tags directly within list views, making content organization more efficient and intuitive.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly integrate and interact with a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to gather insights from all your valuable information.
